endpoint_access_values.label: Artois and counter-revolutionary leadership
endpoint_access_values.meaning: Artois's role in the court reaction of 1789, émigré organization, foreign diplomacy, military schemes, and western expeditions.
endpoint_access_values.stance: Artois was a central, energetic but often unrealistic and ineffective leader. His late arrival at Portsmouth and failure to reach the Vendée mainland in 1795 disappointed royalist expectations.
